title: UniPoolerV2 constructor validates only the pair's token set, not pair_ == router.factory().getPair(sUSDS, phUSD); combined with a permissionless, possibly-empty factory pair, the cutover can be decoupled (non-canonical pair) or permanently griefed (dust pre-seed at an arbitrary ratio, MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY lock)
description: Third party createPair + dust mint at skewed ratio before the atomic seed; cutover precondition 0 ('reserves (0,0)') fails forever. Unsafe workaround (relaxing precondition, router add with zero mins) lets griefer arbitrage the protocol seed. No in-repo fund loss today.
impact: Cutover availability: a third party createPair()s and mints dust at a skewed ratio before the protocol seed, so the cutover's reserves==(0,0) precondition fails. No fund loss in-repo: the fail-loud precondition halts the script. Loss arises only if the operator takes the unsafe workaround (router addLiquidity with zero mins into the skewed pair), letting arbitrage take value from the ~100%-protocol LP.
attackPath: 1. Before cutover, griefer calls factory.createPair(sUSDS, phUSD) (if absent) and mints dust at an arbitrary ratio
3. Safe recovery: pre-arbitrage the dust pair to target ratio (profitable against the griefer) then seed via transfer+mint with a reserve-ratio assertion
4. Unsafe recovery: relax precondition / router-add with zero mins -> protocol seeds at the griefer's price and is arbitraged
likelihood: low - griefer gains nothing and loses the skew to arbitrage; harm requires a further operator mistake
assumptions: Pair is empty or absent at cutover time; operator chooses the recovery path
severityJustification: Distinct actor (third party), vector and mitigation from facet A, hence split. Non-obvious (MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY permanence; 'permanently griefed' is overstated - the skew is cheaply and profitably corrected). Delay-only availability impact on a one-off cutover plus a documented-fallback footgun: Low, not Medium. Route to /audit-script on the cutover entry point.
recommendation: documented fallback (direct transfer + pair.mint, or pre-arbitrage to target ratio with reserve-ratio assertion); route to /audit-script on the cutover
knownIssueCheck: No KI match. KI#4 (owner trust) does not cover facet B: the dust pre-seed grief is a THIRD-PARTY action on a permissionless factory pair; facet A (non-canonical pair accepted) is a non-obvious deploy footgun.
ledgerMatch: None. Q-01 98c9fc4523 (fixed, zero-address ctor validation) is a different root cause.
fingerprintNote: PROPOSED new fingerprint for the split; finding-manager to mint. If the owner prefers the consolidated entry, fold back under 0983961...
routeTo: /audit-script on the phStaging2 unipooler-cutover entry point
